name: trivy:scan-images

options.description: Write report without failing when findings are detected.

summary: Scan images referenced by project Dockerfiles and Compose files with Trivy.
help: Finds images referenced by Dockerfiles and Docker Compose files in the selected project path, then scans the referenced registry images for vulnerabilities. The default path is the project root. Writes a JSON report to .docker-dev/reports/trivy-images.json and exits with a non-zero status when Trivy finds vulnerabilities at the configured severity. It does not mount or access the Docker socket.
